resources.string: Captures screen images and scrolls pages to join screenshots locally. Does not read the view hierarchy or record keystrokes. Screen images may contain sensitive content. No network permission.
Enable the screenshot service to show the side button.
Open the page you want to capture, then tap the side button.
Allow restricted settings in the app information screen, then check the accessibility switch.
In system settings, find Lianye and enable its accessibility service.
All processing stays on this device. No network permission.
Lianye uses accessibility to capture screen images and scroll the page. On Android 10, screen capture needs a separate system authorization.
Setting names vary by system version. Return here after enabling the service to check the next step.
In Accessibility, find Lianye under General → Downloaded apps and enable it.
In Accessibility, find Lianye under Downloaded apps and enable it. Some versions place this under General.
In Accessibility, find Lianye under Downloaded apps or services and enable it.
In Accessibility, open Installed services and enable Lianye.
In Accessibility, open Installed services and enable Lianye.
In Accessibility, open Installed apps and enable Lianye.
In Accessibility, open Downloaded apps and enable Lianye.
Accessibility → Downloaded apps → %1$s (under General on some versions)
Some versions call this Downloaded services. If the names differ, search Settings for Accessibility.
Some versions place Downloaded apps under General. If the names differ, search Settings for Accessibility.
Older versions may call this Installed services. If the names differ, search Settings for Accessibility.
If the names differ, search Settings for Accessibility and find Lianye.
Some systems restrict apps installed outside an app store. Try these steps:
1. Open the app information screen below.
2. Open the top-right menu and select Allow restricted settings, if available.
3. Verify your identity, then return and check the accessibility switch.
The restriction status cannot be confirmed. Return to accessibility settings and check whether the service can be enabled.
The service switch is in accessibility settings, not app information.
Hiding the side button keeps the service enabled. Disabling the service stops screenshot access.
Capture a page and join it on your phone. Review, optionally crop, then save or share.
Screen images are processed on this device. The app has no network permission, advertising or tracking.

Accessibility captures screen images and scrolls pages. It does not read the view hierarchy or record keystrokes. Screenshots may contain sensitive content. Android 10 also asks for screen capture authorization.
Going back keeps the current draft. A new capture replaces it; saving writes to your gallery and sharing sends temporary images to the app you choose.
When the service switch is unavailable
Some Android versions restrict apps installed outside an app store. The setting may differ by device.
1. Try the Lianye switch in accessibility settings and read the system prompt.
2. Open app information and check the top-right menu for Allow restricted settings.
3. After verification, return to accessibility settings and enable the service.
If the system repeatedly stops the service, review battery settings. The ADB command is for experienced users with a connected computer.
Open source · No ads · MIT license\nVersion %1$s
Android 10 requires a separate system authorization to capture screen images. If access expires, authorize again.
Screen capture authorized. Checking screenshot readiness.
Screen capture was not authorized. You can try again.
1. Enable the screenshot service and show the side button.
1. Open the page you want to capture.
2. Tap the side button to start; tap Finish to stop.
3. Review the result, then save or share.
Open app information → More → Allow restricted settings, if available. Verify your identity, then return to accessibility settings and enable Lianye.
Scroll automatically. Join it into one image.
Enable screen capture and scrolling first. Then open the page you want to capture.
One more step: Android 10 needs screen capture authorization.
Show the side button, then open the page you want to capture.
Open the page you want to capture. Tap the side button to start, then Finish when you have enough.
Your current screenshot is kept here. Continue reviewing and editing, or start a new one.
The result is in your gallery. You can keep editing or start a new screenshot.
Return to the page being captured. The side button shows progress and lets you finish.
